name: disband-commercial
description: Frame-accurate renderer for the Disband promotional films (16:9 commercials and the 9:16 social spot).

scripts.build: npm run capture && npm run audio && npm run render && npm run encode
scripts.android:audio: node tools/timeline-json.mjs android/timeline.js build/android-timeline.json && TIMELINE=build/android-timeline.json python3 tools/audio_android.py
scripts.android:encode: AUDIO=build/audio/android-mix.wav TITLE='Disband — Android beta' tools/encode.sh build/android-frames 60 build/disband-android-beta-16x9-1080p.mp4
scripts.android:build: npm run capture && npm run android:audio && npm run android:render && npm run android:encode
scripts.vertical:audio: node tools/timeline-json.mjs vertical/timeline.js build/vertical-timeline.json && TIMELINE=build/vertical-timeline.json python3 tools/audio_vertical.py
scripts.vertical:encode: AUDIO=build/audio/vertical-mix.wav TITLE='Disband — Your Space. Your Privacy.' tools/encode.sh build/vertical-frames 60 build/disband-vertical-9x16-1080p.mp4
scripts.vertical:build: npm run capture && npm run vertical:layers && npm run vertical:audio && npm run vertical:render && npm run vertical:encode
scripts.connect:audio: node tools/timeline-json.mjs connect/timeline.js build/connect-timeline.json && TIMELINE=build/connect-timeline.json python3 tools/audio_connect.py
scripts.connect:encode: AUDIO=build/audio/connect-mix.wav TITLE='Disband — A New Way to Connect.' tools/encode.sh build/connect-frames 60 build/disband-connect-9x16-1080p.mp4
scripts.connect:build: npm run capture && npm run vertical:layers && npm run connect:audio && npm run connect:render && npm run connect:encode
scripts.loud:audio: node tools/timeline-json.mjs loud/timeline.js build/loud-timeline.json && TIMELINE=build/loud-timeline.json python3 tools/audio_loud.py
scripts.loud:encode: AUDIO=build/audio/loud-mix.wav TITLE='Disband — The internet is loud.' tools/encode.sh build/loud-frames 60 build/disband-loud-9x16-1080p.mp4
scripts.loud:build: npm run capture && npm run vertical:layers && npm run loud:audio && npm run loud:render && npm run loud:encode
scripts.nextapp:audio: node tools/timeline-json.mjs nextapp/timeline.js build/nextapp-timeline.json && TIMELINE=build/nextapp-timeline.json python3 tools/audio_nextapp.py
scripts.nextapp:encode: AUDIO=build/audio/nextapp-mix.wav TITLE='Disband — Not another boring app.' tools/encode.sh build/nextapp-frames 60 build/disband-nextapp-9x16-1080p.mp4
scripts.nextapp:build: npm run capture && npm run vertical:layers && npm run nextapp:audio && npm run nextapp:render && npm run nextapp:encode
